sections.name: Architecture & Structure

findings.title: No clear layered architecture detected
findings.description: Code does not appear to follow a clear layered architecture (MVC, Clean Architecture, etc.)
findings.recommendation: Consider organizing code into clear layers: presentation, business logic, data access
findings.root_cause: Lack of architectural planning or gradual architectural drift

findings.title: Large average file size indicates poor separation of concerns
findings.description: Average file size: 378 lines. Files should be smaller and more focused.
findings.recommendation: Break down large files into smaller, single-responsibility modules
findings.root_cause: Lack of refactoring discipline, unclear module boundaries

recommendations: Implement dependency injection for better testability

sections.name: Code Quality & Patterns
sections.summary: Analyzed code quality patterns. Found 2 issues.

findings.title: Excessive use of magic numbers
findings.description: Found magic numbers in 6 files. Use named constants instead.
findings.recommendation: Extract magic numbers into named constants or configuration
findings.root_cause: Lack of constant extraction during development

findings.title: Multiple long functions detected
findings.description: Found 28 functions exceeding 50 lines. Functions should be smaller and focused.
findings.recommendation: Apply Extract Method refactoring to break down long functions
findings.root_cause: Insufficient refactoring, violation of Single Responsibility Principle

recommendations: Use linters and formatters (pylint, black, flake8)
Implement automated code quality gates in CI/CD

sections.name: SOLID Principles
sections.summary: Evaluated SOLID principles adherence. Found 0 violations.
recommendations: Review classes with >300 lines or >15 methods
Use interfaces/abstract classes for dependency inversion

sections.name: Security & Risk Assessment
sections.summary: Assessed security posture. Found 1 security issues.

findings.title: SQL injection risk detected
findings.description: Found potential SQL injection vulnerabilities in 10 files.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or ORM instead of string concatenation
findings.root_cause: Improper input sanitization and query construction

recommendations: Implement security scanning in CI/CD pipeline

findings.title: Multiple nested loops detected
findings.description: Found 18 instances of deeply nested loops (O(n²) or worse).
findings.recommendation: Consider using hash maps, sets, or optimized algorithms to reduce complexity
findings.root_cause: Algorithmic inefficiency, lack of performance analysis

findings.title: Potential N+1 query problem
findings.description: Found 12 instances of potential N+1 query patterns.
findings.recommendation: Use eager loading, batch queries, or caching to avoid N+1 problems
findings.root_cause: Lack of query optimization, ORM misuse
